text: There is a new entry-level Mac laptop, powered by an A-series chip
full-pick-text: There is a new entry-level Mac laptop, powered by an A-series chip. Apple calls it the MacBook, but mentions or shows the original colorful iBooks. It has MagSafe and two USB-C (not Thunderbolt) ports. The base SKU has 8 GB of RAM, isn't available in all colors, and starts at $699
notes:
